Local OCR assets, used only on the user's device:
- Tesseract.js 5.1.1 and Tesseract.js-core 6.1.2, bundled from npm; licenses are alongside the files.
- `eng.traineddata.gz` and `rus.traineddata.gz` from `https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast/`, based on the open Tesseract language data. See https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast for license and source.

The browser loads all scripts and model files from this application's own origin. Recognition is a suggestion requiring manual review. The application does not upload images for OCR.
